SamenvattingDo you have a passion for logistics and feel at home in a warehouse environment? Then this role is for you. As a Reach Truck Driver at Nedcargo in Waddinxveen, you play a key role in keeping the warehouse running smoothly. You safely move pallets, prepare outgoing shipments, and check incoming goods. Good work!Over de functieAs a reach truck driver, you are responsible for safely transporting and storing pallets containing a variety of products such as snacks, sauces, and alcoholic beverages. You work accurately, keep an eye on quality, and immediately report any irregularities.
Your main tasks include:
Moving, storing, and preparing goods within the warehouse
Loading and unloading pallets safely and efficiently
Checking incoming and outgoing goods for accuracy and quality
Keeping your workspace clean and organized

You will work 5 days per week on a rotating schedule from Monday to Sunday, with two days off per week.
Working hours (two shifts):
05:00 – 14:00
14:15 – 23:15

Over het bedrijfNedcargo is a leading logistics service provider specializing in the transport, storage, and distribution of food, beverages, and consumer goods. With modern facilities and a strong network, Nedcargo ensures a smooth and reliable supply chain.
Sustainability and innovation are at the heart of the company. Working here means joining a professional, dynamic environment with real opportunities to grow and develop your career.
Wat wij vragenYou speak Dutch or English and can communicate well with colleagues
You have your own accommodation
You hold a valid reach truck certificate
You have at least 1 year of experience operating a reach truck in a warehouse
No certificate yet? No problem — if you’re motivated, we will help you obtain it
You are available to work in a two-shift system

We are also curious about who you are beyond your experience. Tell us about your skills, background, and what motivates you — we’d love to hear it!

SamenvattingAre you an experienced Reachtruck Driver looking for a new opportunity in Waddinxveen? Join DACHSER and work in a modern warehouse with a great team, good salary, and opportunities to grow. Apply today. Good work!Over de functieAs a Reachtruck Driver in Waddinxveen, you will work in a modern Food Logistics warehouse where you make sure goods are stored safely and ready for transport on time. You will operate a reachtruck in both chilled and freezer areas while working together with your colleagues to keep the warehouse running smoothly.
Your daily tasks include:
- Operate the reachtruck and safely transport pallets
- Store and retrieve goods from warehouse racks
- Load and unload trucks
- Scan goods using a handheld scanner
- Check incoming goods for quantity and damage
- Keep the warehouse clean, organised, and safe

You will work in temperature-controlled areas, including a chilled warehouse (+4°C) and a freezer (-20°C). Warm work clothing is provided by DACHSER.
Working hours are:
- 07:00 - 16:00
- 09:00 - 19:00

Over het bedrijfDACHSER is one of the world's leading logistics companies with a strong family-business culture. Every day, thousands of employees work together to deliver smart and reliable logistics solutions for customers around the world.
At DACHSER, teamwork, respect, and personal development are important. You will work in a modern warehouse with supportive colleagues and have plenty of opportunities to learn and grow within the company.

- Experience as a reachtruck driver or warehouse employee
- Comfortable working in a chilled and freezer environment
- You work safely, accurately, and responsibly
- You are motivated and enjoy working in a team
- You speak Dutch or English

These points are important to start as a Reachtruck Driver in Waddinxveen. We are also interested in who you are. Your motivation, experience, and personality matter just as much.
